title: [bug] pre-existing: test_lci_auth expects 4.04 for unauthenticated location POST but resource returns 4.05
description: tests/coap/test_lci_auth.py::TestObservableAuth::test_sensors_location_no_post fails at HEAD commit 1d31da4dc7 (verified by stash-isolation, not caused by 2026-08-25 vector work). Resource exists and rejects POST with 4.05 Method Not Allowed; test asserts 4.04 Not Found. Either the resource should hide POST (return 4.04 per LCI authz model in spec 17 - unknown/mutable resource discovery semantics) or the test expectation is stale after observability changes to SenMLLocationResource. Needs human/product decision; do not weaken either side without spec check.
close_reason: Fixed by wave-fix: Changed test expectation from NOT_FOUND to METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED for POST on read-only location resource
